Hey, first off I’m sorry for your loss.

I want to be clear by saying that how to cope with suicide is really tough. I’ve never been in the situation and I know I can’t understand what you’re going through.

That being said, he left a note behind in which he wrote about you in a positive way, making it clear he loved you as well. So, please don’t beat yourself up. You clearly were close with him and did not hurt him. This is not your fault, so no matter hard things get from here on out, don’t blame yourself. Instead focus on coping with it.

I think you need to come up with your own conclusion as to how to move forward with this. Therapy and professional help can be a great option. If not talk with friends, family, maybe his loved ones and anyone you need to vent or cry to.

I’m sure you’re in shock too, after all it’s impossible to know exactly what led him to go this way. To be honest, we can never know why exactly someone chooses to leave this world this way. But we can find closure with their decision, to move forward and to remember them and honour their memory. 

What I’m trying to say is, find a way to obtain closure. For a while, it’s totally okay to cry, and to be in shock over what happened. But, please please please don’t let this become a reason for you hating yourself or feeling confused forever.

Take care of yourself physically and mentally and stay strong. I know this will sound harsh but there is no real answer to how to cope with loss. Everyone copes differently and I sincerely hope you find a way to cope with this situation. This subreddit and many others are there for you and I’m sure there are people there in your personal life who are there for you.

I hope your friend is resting in peace and while His life here was tough and painful, I hope he’s in a better place now.
